Priya: Nightly run (nightly-refresh-and-bench) failed at the shard-assembler step and aborted the bench-suite v2.1.0. Error shows \"ShardTimeoutError: waited 300s for shard-assembly\". Started ~03:12 UTC. @oncall can someone quick-check S3 read latencies for the checkpoints prefix? :eyes:

Sam: Ouch. Can you paste the last 20 lines of the job log?

Priya: Sure:
```
2026-03-16T03:14:05Z ERROR shard-assembler: ShardTimeoutError: waited 300s for shard-assembly (shard_id=us-west-2_i-03)
2026-03-16T03:14:05Z DEBUG s3: HeadObject for s3://redwood-models/checkpoints/m-12/part-3 timed out after 30s
2026-03-16T03:14:06Z INFO retrying fetch (attempt=1)
2026-03-16T03:14:35Z ERROR shard-assembler: ShardTimeoutError: waited 300s for shard-assembly (attempt=2)
```

Liam: Looks like a hotspot on part-3. Did the scheduler pick a different host than usual? Could be a corrupted object or a regional network blip.

Priya: Our past runs evenly hit parts 0-7; part-3 has shown elevated latencies in the last 6 runs. Noticed a small uptick in 5xxs in metrics.

CI-bot: Build #4582 of bench-e2e failed: `test_inference_streaming` (flake). Full CI logs: https://ci.redwood/4582

Sam: The CI flake might be downstream from the partial model load, but let's isolate the shard first. Proposal: rerun the nightly with `--force-shard=3` to see if the failure reproduces deterministically. If it does, bisect model-sync commits.

Priya: Kicking a manual rerun now: `rerun_cron nightly-refresh-and-bench --shard 3 --reason \"isolate shard-assembly timeout\"`. Also started a bisect job over model-sync commits range 1701..1720 to see when part-3 started failing. Assigning the bisect to @Liam. :calendar:

Liam: I will watch the rerun. If rerun succeeds, likely a transient S3/infra issue. If it fails consistently, I'll run the bisect and narrow the offending manifest change and open a rollback PR to pin the manifest to the previous good commit.

Ana: FYI I pulled S3 metrics for `checkpoints/m-12/part-3` — there was a 45m window of elevated 4xx/5xx between 03:00-03:45 UTC. Cloud infra has a maint event listed around 02:50-03:10 UTC in us-west-2. Filing internal ticket (CLOUD-4321) to correlate.

Priya: Thanks Ana. Rerun is in progress (job #nightly-2176543210-try1). I'll update when it finishes. Tagging with #triage.

Sam: ping @Liam after rerun completes — if it fails, please start the bisect and post the first failing commit range. :thumbsup:
